question: Can exact programs on two bijective four-real-hole coordinate spaces decide forced positivity relative to a fixed finite Boolean property algebra and declared policies?
level: External exact finite calibration; no native semantic authority

programs.domain: a > 0 and y > 0; target a > 0 and q > 0
programs.source: p = a*x+b; q = a*y; d = p*p+q*q; retain(a,b,-p/d,q/d)
programs.retained_equivalence: A rational coordinate bijection and region-incidence transport on the frozen finite carrier; no expression-word, source, occurrence, history or cell equivalence

assumptions: Four frozen legal fillings only; exact rational arithmetic
All 16 subsets are properties; the two observations generate four distinct atoms
Static A1 means exactly one of a region and its complement is positive
Static A2 means positivity is upward closed under subset inclusion
Joint policy additionally requires an actual point in every positive region
Marked policy additionally fixes the realizing point to source index 2
No modal A3, A4, A5, general higher-order property domain or intrinsic positivity is implemented
interface: decide(query_mask, positive_masks, negative_masks, policy, fuel) -> classification, model witnesses and separate realization witness

checker.producer: Enumerate all 256 complement choices and check all 81 subset incidences
checker.independent: Separately derive all upward families from 65,536 subset families using ordinary sets; compare complete model families, case classifications, returned witnesses and geometric incidence
negative_controls: Three individually inhabited positive regions have empty common intersection
Forgetting a,b collides source index 2 with (2,1,0,1) and prevents marked positivity descent
Division without its nonzero guard admits the spurious equation 0*y=0
Changed witness or coordinate evidence is rejected
checker.acceptance: Both ordinary and optimized producer runs byte-identical; independent receiver accepts exact evidence and rejects deliberate mutations; all 16 query results and all 12 basic model families transport across the reversed target order

protected_obligations: Only external indices, never SourceId, OccurrenceId or native certificates
Coordinate transport does not authorize native rewrites or objectification
Inhabited regions are not automatically positive
Universality is not assigned a positivity value by this finite carrier
No stable kernel changes, dependency-lock changes, catalog growth or Pascal obligation discharge
Unknown and InvalidInput cannot be interpreted as nonexistence

budget.test_receiver_cache: At most one independently derived immutable model table per test process; checking mutations still counted, with no producer table trusted
budget.output_limit_scope: Per file, enforced by RLIMIT_FSIZE in each child; stdout and stderr go to exclusive regular files, not unbounded captured pipes
budget.cpu_limit_scope: Aggregate parent and child CPU; parent hard limit and each child's remaining aggregate allowance with one second reserved for parent bookkeeping
budget.checkpoint_policy: No continuation checkpoint or fuel reset; source hashes frozen before launching the single campaign; failures retained outside the repository for an explicitly revised finite contract

exit: Stop after the five bounded child launches or any failure/limit. Limits yield Unknown, not Inconsistent. Integration checks are documentary checks outside this semantic campaign.
cross_domain_justification: Represent finite geometric observations as exact region incidence; transport complement, inclusion and common intersection along the explicit coordinate bijection, then solve a separately declared finite positivity theory.
